item.title: Mexico brings back bison 160 years after extinction; 47 animals are restoring the ecosystem
item.description: After an absence of 160 years, American bison have made a remarkable comeback to Coahuila, Mexico. These majestic animals have become vital ecosystem engineers, actively rejuvenating worn-out landscapes. Their presence enhances soil quality and promotes water absorption in the dry terrain. Additionally, this return facilitates the resurgence of native predators and other wildlife, reflecting a wider initiative aimed at restoring vital species throughout North America. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
